content.overview: Section 378ZM prescribes penalties for specified contraventions: unauthorized use of the words “Producer Company Limited” by a person other than a Producer Company registered under Chapter XXIA; wilful failure by a director or officer to furnish information about the Producer Company's affairs when duly required; and specified failures by a director or officer to hand over books, documents or property, or to convene general meetings.
content.glance: Section 378ZM covers three specified categories of contravention and provides distinct fines and, for wilful information refusal, possible imprisonment.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZM (Penalty for contravention). Subsection (1) penalizes a person other than a Producer Company registered under Chapter XXIA who carries on business under a name containing “Producer Company Limited”, with a fine up to ₹10,000 for every day the name is used. Subsection (2) provides that a director or officer who wilfully fails to furnish information relating to the Producer Company's affairs required by a Member or a person duly authorized for that purpose is liable to imprisonment up to six months and a fine equivalent to five per cent of the Company's turnover during the preceding financial year. Subsection (3) provides a fine up to ₹1,00,000 where a director or officer fails to hand over books, documents or property in their custody to the Producer Company, or fails to convene an annual general meeting or other general meeting; for continuing default, an additional fine up to ₹10,000 for every day it continues. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Unauthorized use of the name
sections.body: A person other than a Producer Company registered under Chapter XXIA who carries on business under a name containing the words “Producer Company Limited” is punishable with a fine that may extend to ₹10,000 for every day the name is used.

sections.heading: Wilful failure to furnish information
sections.body: A director or officer who wilfully fails to furnish information relating to the affairs of the Producer Company required by a Member or a person duly authorized in this behalf is liable to imprisonment for a term that may extend to six months and a fine equivalent to five per cent of the Company's turnover during the preceding financial year.

sections.heading: Failure to hand over records/property or convene meetings
sections.body: A director or officer who fails to hand over custody of books of account, other documents or property in their custody to the Producer Company, or fails to convene an annual general meeting or other general meeting, is punishable with a fine that may extend to ₹1,00,000. For continuing default or failure, an additional fine may extend to ₹10,000 for every day the default or failure continues.

examples.title: Classifying a section 378ZM issue
examples.body: Identify which subsection is engaged, the person covered, the specific conduct, and the penalty stated for that subsection. Do not transfer the penalty or conditions of one subsection to another.

hypotheticals.question: A director fails to convene an annual general meeting, and the default continues. Which section 378ZM penalty provision is relevant?
hypotheticals.analysis: Subsection (3) addresses a director's or officer's failure to convene an annual general meeting or other general meeting. Identify the base fine limit and, if the default continues, the additional daily fine limit stated in that subsection. Verify the current statutory text before applying a penalty to a real matter.

distinctions.title: Distinct contraventions under section 378ZM
distinctions.left: Subsection (1): unauthorized use of the name “Producer Company Limited”.
distinctions.right: Subsections (2) and (3): specified director/officer information and governance defaults.

rows.left: A person other than a Producer Company registered under Chapter XXIA using the specified name in business
rows.right: A director or officer committing one of the specified defaults
Subsection (2) includes possible imprisonment and turnover-based fine; subsection (3) includes a base and continuing-default fine

misconceptions.trap: Applying the daily fine for unauthorized name use to every contravention under section 378ZM.
misconceptions.correction: Match the conduct to the subsection; each subsection has a different penalty structure.

misconceptions.trap: Treating any failure to furnish information as sufficient for subsection (2).
misconceptions.correction: The text specifies wilful failure to furnish information required by a Member or a person duly authorized for that purpose.

misconceptions.trap: Ignoring the continuing-default component under subsection (3).
misconceptions.correction: Where the specified default continues, subsection (3) provides an additional daily fine limit.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378zm do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: A Producer Company or an officer who contravenes the provisions of this Chapter is punishable as the section provides.
